purpose: Gate C descriptive robustness analysis; base metric contract and customer population remain unchanged
scoring_sensitivity: Multiply all recency, frequency and monetary upper boundaries jointly by each configured threshold_sensitivity_multiplier; gross and net share each scenario's boundaries; keep segment-score sums fixed
boundary_arithmetic: Exact decimal multiplication without integer rounding; inclusive upper boundaries; integer observations compare directly against fractional boundaries
review_group: Gross-segment by net-segment cell within ALL or assigned-country scope; compare cell customer count with configured minimum_review_customers_sensitivity using inclusive >=
review_interpretation: A group-size safeguard for investigation display; not statistical significance, profitability, campaign suitability or permission to hide factual counts
cohort_review_denominator: Customers with complete individual 90-day follow-up; show original cohort size, incomplete customers and whether the whole observed cohort is eligible
ambiguity_sensitivity: Exclude simultaneous-first or multi-timestamp-invoice customers only in separately labeled diagnostic comparisons; preserve base eligibility and outcomes
source_start_sensitivity: Exclude the entire first observed calendar-month cohort in a separately labeled diagnostic comparison; this does not resolve left censoring in other cohorts
exposure_interpretation: Full-window frequency has unequal observed exposure; end-of-window RFM must not be used as a prospective validation of earlier 90-day repeat outcomes
